description: List merge requests in a GitLab project, optionally filtered by state.

page.description: Optional page number of results to return.

per_page.description: Optional number of results to return per page.

project_id.description: The GitLab project identifier: a numeric ID or URL-encoded project path.

state.description: Optional merge request state filter, such as opened, closed, or merged.

name: list_merge_requests
